data.title: CSD submits exam fraud files to NACC
data.description: Crime Suppression Division (CSD) investigators have submitted more than 3,000 pages of documents in the civil service exam fraud case to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) for consideration in legal action.

data.title: New Wave of Industrial FDI and Tech Shift Offsets Domestic Housing Slump, Says Frasers Property Thailand
data.description: FPT's CEO says FDI in semiconductors and data infrastructure is offsetting a housing slump driven by record household debt

data.title: What to know about the total solar eclipse
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Day will briefly turn into night across a swathe of northern Spain on Wednesday, when the Moon will completely cover the Sun during a rare total solar eclipse.

data.title: Total solar eclipse to spellbind Europe
data.description: BURGOS (SPAIN) - Millions of Europeans will contemplate the sky in awe on Wednesday as a rare total solar eclipse crosses part of the continent and plunges a swathe of Spain into eerie daytime darkness.

data.title: Court sets Nov 23 for Facebook lawsuits
data.description: A legal battle brought by the Thailand Consumers Council against businesses allegedly involved in online scams conducted through Facebook has moved forward, with the Bangkok South Civil Court scheduling the next hearing for Nov 23.

data.title: Students at city schools to face no extra charges
data.description: The city administration is preparing a formal announcement to ensure students at its 437 schools face no extra maintenance charges.

data.title: Sex workers urge PM to back rights bill
data.description: Sex worker rights groups on Tuesday urged Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to endorse a citizen-sponsored bill seeking legal protection and labour rights for sex workers.

data.title: Dual nationality issues set for talks
data.description: Thailand will seek Malaysia's cooperation in addressing long-standing problems involving dual nationals along the border amid concerns over its potential security implications in the southern border provinces, National Security Council (NSC) secretary-general Chatchai Bangchuad said on Tuesday.

data.title: Five-time MP Krieng dies at 74
data.description: Krieng Kalptinan, a former deputy interior minister and five-time MP for Ubon Ratchathani, died peacefully on Tuesday at Vichaiyut Hospital after battling cancer. He was 74.

data.title: BAAC chief faces backlash from staff
data.description: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas is set to convene an urgent board meeting over employee protests demanding the resignation of Chatchai Sirilai, president of the Bank for Agriculture and Agricultural Cooperatives (BAAC).

data.title: Cabinet backs wider milk access
data.description: The cabinet has approved expanding the school milk programme to cover secondary school students (Grade 7-9) from November.

data.title: Cabinet approves 7-point school safety plan
data.description: <p>The cabinet on Tuesday approved seven urgent measures to strengthen safety at schools nationwide following last week's shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School, including screening for weapons, illegal items and drugs before anyone enters school premises.</p>

data.title: Govt boosts flood-response funds
data.description: Deputy prime ministers will each receive 100 million baht in emergency funding to tackle flooding and prepare for drought across the nation.

data.title: Trump's secret plane swap triggers questions and confusion
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A secret operation that reportedly smuggled Donald Trump off Air Force One in a catering truck before the plane departed carrying journalists and staff at apparent risk of an Iranian strike has raised questions over US security practices.

data.title: Colombia scrambles to find survivors as quake kills 240
data.description: PEREIRA (COLOMBIA) - Colombian volunteers on Tuesday dredged through rubble, searching for survivors from an earthquake that killed at least 240 people and leveled more than a hundred homes and office buildings.

data.title: UN says 2 staff arrested by Afghan intelligence agency
data.description: KABUL - Two staff members of the United Nations mission in Afghanistan have been arrested by the country's intelligence agency, the world body told AFP on Tuesday, adding that it had no access to them for two days.

data.title: Pereira, the 'zombie city' devastated by Colombia's earthquake
data.description: PEREIRA (COLOMBIA) - Jorge Gonzalez searches with his bare hands for his aunt under the ruins of a four-story building in Pereira, one of the cities hardest hit by the powerful earthquake in Colombia that has left at least 240 dead.

data.title: Cabinet backs civil service overhaul to rein in personnel costs
data.description: The cabinet on Tuesday approved a civil service reform programme aimed at reducing the public-sector workforce by 15% by 2032.

data.title: Flight cancelled after child refuses to buckle seat belt
data.description: A Canadian airline was forced to cancel a cross-country flight last week after a small child would not sit down and buckle a seat belt before takeoff.

data.title: Pilot in Phuket-Delhi flight incident ‘tested positive for marijuana’
data.description: NEW DELHI - The ‌captain of an Air India Phuket-Delhi flight that suddenly lost about 300 feet of altitude last week has tested positive for marijuana in a confirmatory ​drug test, multiple ⁠Indian media outlets reported on Tuesday.

data.title: Israel demolishes home of Palestinian killed in West Bank clash
data.description: TELL, Palestinian Territories - Israeli forces on Tuesday demolished the home of a Palestinian who died in July in the most lethal clash in months in the occupied West Bank, residents and the army told AFP.

data.title: Court says Social Security Board election can proceed
data.description: The Central Administrative Court on Tuesday ordered the revocation of an announcement postponing the Social Security Board election, ruling that the announcement was unlawful.

data.title: Israel demolishes home of Palestinian involved in West Bank clash
data.description: TELL, Palestinian Territories - Israeli forces on Tuesday demolished the home of a Palestinian who died in July in the most lethal clash in months in the occupied West Bank, residents and the army told AFP.

data.title: Europeans race to find protective glasses for solar eclipse
data.description: MADRID - The scramble for protective glasses has reached fever pitch across Europe ahead of Wednesday’s rare total solar eclipse, as pharmacies, opticians and other shops struggle to keep them in stock.

data.title: Air India CEO summoned over Phuket-Delhi flight incident
data.description: NEW DELHI - India’s civil aviation minister ​has summoned Air ‌India CEO Campbell Wilson after a pilot tested positive for drugs following an incident on a Phuket-Delhi flight, ​a ⁠source with direct knowledge of the matter said on Tuesday.

data.title: ‘World’s best pastry chef’ stays true to artisan roots
data.description: PARIS - The smell of warm bread hangs in the air at one of Benoit Castel’s patisseries in Paris, where the newly crowned world’s best pastry chef was hard at work testing new recipes.

data.title: Thai Cabinet backs income tax exemption for ACAI’s foreign staff
data.description: The measure would cover salaries and remuneration received from Thursday (June 6, 2024), while the Finance Ministry estimates an annual revenue loss of THB1.7 million.

data.title: Jaspal Group expands regional fashion and lifestyle portfolio with SATUR launch
data.description: Jaspal Group , or Jaspal Public Company Limited, is reinforcing its position as “a regional fashion and lifestyle house of brands” , drawing on its strengths in developing and growing its own brands while serving as a strategic partner for international brands looking to establish and expand their presence in Thailand and across the region.

data.title: Syria sentences Assad to death in absentia for atrocities
data.description: DAMASCUS - A Syrian court on Tuesday sentenced former ruler Bashar al-Assad to death after a trial in absentia, convicting him of atrocities committed during the country’s nearly 14-year civil war.

data.title: The Global Economic Forum Annual Meeting Bangkok Legacy Week 10th to 14th October 2026
data.description: Asia’s foremost economic platform extends an overarching invitation to sovereign governments, public policy architects, global CEOs, institutional investors, trade associations, civil society organizations, and academic institutions from more than 100 countries to shape regional economic strategy, advance research and innovation, and drive cross-border investment as the strategic prelude to Bangkok’s major international financial assemblies.

data.title: French homebuyers rethink choices after heatwaves
data.description: PARIS - After multiple severe heatwaves in a single summer, French residents are increasingly factoring high temperatures into their home searches, realtors say, bumping up features such as shutters, air conditioning and indirect sunlight on their priority lists.

data.title: Motorcyclist loses race with barrier at Makkasan crossing
data.description: A motorcyclist attempting to bypass a railway barrier near the Makkasan station in Bangkok on Monday ended up losing control and crashing onto the tracks.

data.title: Thai PM suspends firearm purchase licences after school shooting
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul ​on Tuesday suspended the issuance of permits ​to buy firearms and ‌said existing licences would be reviewed, days after a 14-year-old gunman killed nine people.
